blocks.title: Design patterns
blocks.text: Design patterns software development mein aam masail ke aazmooda hal hain. Yeh naqshe (blueprints) ya saanche (templates) ka kaam karte hain jinhein mukhtalif design ke masail hal karne ke liye dhaala ja sakta hai, jis se development zyada kaarkard aur yaksan hoti hai.

Design patterns ka tasawwur Erich Gamma, Richard Helm, Ralph Johnson aur John Vlissides, jinhein 'Gang of Four' kaha jata hai, ki kitab 'Design Patterns: Elements of Reusable Object-Oriented Software' ne mashhoor kiya. Bohat se mashhoor frameworks aur libraries design patterns se bane hain; maslan Model-View-Controller (MVC) pattern Ruby on Rails aur Angular jaise web frameworks mein istemal hota hai (Did You Know).

blocks.prompt: Design pattern ek jumle mein kya hai?
blocks.explanation: Software design ke kisi aam masle ka aazmooda, dobara istemal hone wala hal ka saancha.

items: Design patterns: aam design masail ke aazmooda, dobara istemal hone wale saanche; 'Gang of Four' ki kitab ne mashhoor kiye; MVC Ruby on Rails aur Angular mein.
